reasoning.text: Accelerate and proceed straight through the intersection to follow our route, as the lead vehicle pulls away and our path is clear.
Decelerate to yield to the pedestrian crossing the road at the crosswalk ahead.
Decelerate to yield to the pedestrian crossing the street at the crosswalk.
Decelerate to a stop to yield to the oncoming cyclist approaching in the opposite lane.
Accelerate to resume normal cruising speed, as the vehicle ahead has cleared our lane and the lead vehicle is pulling away.
Decelerate to maintain a safe following distance behind the slowing lead vehicle ahead.
Decelerate to maintain a safe following distance behind the lead vehicle and to accommodate a scooter merging into our lane ahead.
Decelerate to maintain a safe following distance behind the lead vehicle as it slows down ahead.
